title: Annotatio IV §.XIV close: true real presence in spiritual mode (John 6) — stop before §.XV
pass_a_gloss: By these words distinctly inculcating both the true and real presence of Christ’s body in the Sacred Supper and the sole genuine mode of this presence defined by Christ in John 6 — i.e. the spiritual. To which end also the last alleged words of this Homily come to be interpreted, namely that they do not deny the real presence of Christ’s suffered and crucified body in the Sacred Supper, but only the corporal presence opposed to the spiritual asserted in the Homily.
pass_b_english: These words inculcate both true real presence in the Sacred Supper and the sole genuine mode Christ defined in John 6 — the spiritual.
The Homily’s close does not deny real presence of the suffered body — only corporal presence opposed to the spiritual. Stop before §.XV (Hildebrandine / Berengar).
source_text: Hisce verbis tam veram & realem corporis Christi in S. Cena præsentiam, quàm unicum hujus præsentiæ genuinumque modum, à Christo Johan. VI. definitum, i. e. spiritualem, disertè inculcans. Quorsum etiam postrema Homiliæ hujus allegata verba interpretanda veniunt, ut nimirum non corporis Christi passi & crucifixi præsentiam realem, sed corporalem duntaxat, spirituali, in Homilia asserta, oppositam, in Cena S. inficientur.
